attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Lanturn

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may change Lanturn's type to Water until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Lanturn is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Lanturn becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed after you have used this power, its type changes back to Lightning.

attacks.name: Blinding Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

cards.name: Magcargo

abilities.name: Magma Pool
abilities.text: If Magcargo is your Active Pokémon and moves to the Bench, remove 1 Fire Energy card attached to Magcargo, if any, and attach it to the new Active Pokémon. (You can't choose an Energy card that you used to pay the Retreat Cost.)

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Octazooka
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokémon attacks, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching or evolving that Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

cards.name: Parasect

abilities.name: Allergic Pollen
abilities.text: As long as Parasect is in play, cards in any player's discard piles are not affected by attacks or Pokémon Powers. This power stops working if Parasect becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sleep Pinchers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from Piloswine. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: High-Speed Charge
attacks.text: Piloswine does 30 damage to itself. Piloswine can't use this attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

cards.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Horn Swipe
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Terrorize
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, choose 1 of its attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Overhead Toss
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

cards.name: Unown [B]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Bear]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name to Unown [B]. This power can't be used if Unown [B] has 10 HP left. This power can be used even if Unown [B] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [Y]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Yield]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can be used even if Unown [Y] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Grab
attacks.text: Choose a Trainer card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Positive Ion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Negative Ion
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks Chinchou during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Chinchou is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Leek Jab
attacks.text: This attack can't be used during your next turn. (Benching Farfetch'd ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

cards.name: Goldeen

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon card named Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Flock Attack
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Murkrows on your Bench. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Sleep Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

cards.name: Quagsire

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Needle Storm
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads you get.

cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Hard Shell
abilities.text: Whenever an attack (including your own) does 40 or less damage to Shuckle (after applying Weakness and Resistance), reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Shuckle is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Toxic Saliva
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Skiploom

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Magma Ring
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

cards.name: Smoochum
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything else). If tails, your opponent's turn ends.

attacks.name: Psykiss
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Raging Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Snubbull. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Swinub

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Swinub does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

cards.name: Unown [K]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Keep]
abilities.text: Your opponent's attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards can't discard Energy cards from your Pokémon with Unown in their names. (Any other effects still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

cards.name: Balloon Berry
rules: Attach Balloon Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
When the Pokémon Balloon Berry is attached to retreats, discard Balloon Berry instead of discarding Energy cards.

cards.name: Healing Field
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn, he or she may flip a coin. If heads, that player removes 2 damage counters from his or her Active Pokémon (1 if it only has 1).

cards.name: Pokémon Breeder Fields
rules: Flip a coin for 1 or 2 of your non-Baby Pokémon that can evolve. For each heads, search your deck for a later-Stage card that matches that Pokémon. Then put that card into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Hideout
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Each Pokémon in play with Dark in its name (even your opponent's) gets +20 HP.

cards.name: Old Rod
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from your discard pile into your hand. If both are tails, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Shining Gyarados
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Gyarados in your deck.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Shining Gyarados. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Devastate
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to Shining Gyarados or this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Then, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it and discard those Energy cards.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Magikarp in your deck.

attacks.name: Gold Scale
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Bond
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados, or Shining Gyarados. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Dark Ampharos

abilities.name: Conductivity
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to a Pokémon, this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if you have more than 1 Dark Ampharos in play or while Dark Ampharos is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Dark Ampharos or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

cards.name: Dark Crobat

abilities.name: Surprise Bite
abilities.text: When you play Dark Crobat from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Dark Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Remove a number of damage counters from Dark Crobat equal to the damage dealt. If Dark Crobat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

cards.name: Dark Donphan

attacks.name: Tusk Toss
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand. If tails, your opponent chooses 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon and switches it with the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

cards.name: Dark Espeon

attacks.name: Gouge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psysplash
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy card attached to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

cards.name: Dark Feraligatr

abilities.name: Scare
abilities.text: As long as Dark Feraligatr is your Active Pokémon, all of your opponent's Baby Pokémon Powers stop working and your opponent's Baby Pokémon can't attack. This power stops working while Dark Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Crushing Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those cards and discard it.

cards.flavorText: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

cards.name: Dark Gengar

abilities.name: Deep Sleep
abilities.text: As long as any Dark Gengar are in play, a player flips 2 coins for each of his or her Pokémon that is Asleep at the end of each turn. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep. This power stops working if Dark Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Pull In
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon (before doing damage or other effects of this attack). Either way, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

cards.name: Dark Houndoom

attacks.name: Eerie Howl
attacks.text: If your opponent's Bench isn't full, look at his or her hand. If your opponent has any Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon there, choose 1 of them and put it on his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Fire
attacks.text: If there are any Darkness Energy cards attached to Dark Houndoom, discard 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage (plus 10 more damage for the Darkness Energy you discarded). If there aren't any, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

cards.name: Dark Porygon2

abilities.name: Spatial Distortion
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a Stadium card from your discard pile and put it into play. (If there's already a Stadium card in play, discard it.) This power can't be used if Dark Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Curve Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done by attacks to Dark Porygon2 during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

cards.name: Dark Scizor

attacks.name: Threaten
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

cards.name: Dark Typhlosion

attacks.name: Rushing Flames
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to your Pokémon. Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card discarded in this way. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

cards.name: Dark Tyranitar

attacks.name: Mountain Smasher
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fighting Energy cards attached to Dark Tyranitar. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Then, for each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Fling Away
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50 and choose 1 of those Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

cards.name: Light Arcanine

abilities.name: Drive Off
abilities.text: As long as Light Arcanine is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used while Light Arcanine is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Gentle Flames
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Baby Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage instead of 50. If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

cards.name: Light Azumarill

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bubble Jump
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, take 2 Energy cards attached to Light Azumarill and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then return Light Azumarill and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

cards.name: Light Dragonite

abilities.name: Miraculous Wind
abilities.text: As long as Light Dragonite is your Active Pokémon, each Special Energy card provides Colorless Energy instead of its usual type and its other effects stop working. This power stops working while Light Dragonite is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Light Wave
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, other than damage, done to Light Dragonite during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

cards.name: Light Togetic

abilities.name: Gift
abilities.text: When you play Light Togetic from your hand, your opponent may search his or her deck for a Pokémon Tool card, show that card to you, and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

cards.name: Miracle Energy
rules:
You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach Miracle Energy to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy.
While in play, Miracle Energy counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

cards.name: Dark Ariados

attacks.name: Entangle
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon, then flip a coin. If heads, the new Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

cards.name: Dark Magcargo

abilities.name: Hot Plate
abilities.text: As long as Dark Magcargo is your Active Pokémon, whenever a player puts a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Dark Magcargo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ball of Flame
attacks.text: You may discard a Fire Energy card attached to Dark Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

cards.name: Dark Omastar

attacks.name: Prehistoric Water
attacks.text: If your opponent has any evolved Pokémon in play, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes the highest Stage Evolution card on that Pokémon and shuffles it into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Dark Tentacle
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't evolve except from effects of attacks or Pokémon Powers. (Benching that Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

cards.name: Dark Slowking

abilities.name: Cunning
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, you may have your opponent shuffle his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dark Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for this attack.

cards.flavorText: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

cards.name: Dark Ursaring

attacks.name: Provoke
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room). Then, your opponent looks at your hand. If you have any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, your opponent may put any number of them onto your Bench (as long as there's room).

attacks.name: Battle Frenzy
attacks.text: For each Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. For each heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

cards.flavorText: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Light Dragonair

attacks.name: Healing Light
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Protective Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Light Dragonair.

cards.flavorText: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

cards.name: Light Lanturn

attacks.name: Searchlight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, each player may choose a card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

cards.name: Light Ledian

attacks.name: Flash Touch
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, switch 1 of them with Light Ledian. As long as that Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards still happen.)

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

cards.name: Light Machamp

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.text: When you play Light Machamp from your hand, if it is on your Bench, remove 3 damage counters from your Active Pokémon. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Then, switch Light Machamp with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Beatdown
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has Dark in its name or is a Darkness Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 damage instead of 50.

cards.flavorText: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

cards.name: Light Piloswine

abilities.name: Fluffy Wool
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if Light Piloswine is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by your opponent's attack (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. This power stops working if Light Piloswine is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

attacks.name: Knock Over
attacks.text: If there is a Stadium card in play, you may discard it.

cards.flavorText: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

cards.name: Unown [G]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Give]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [G], Unown [I], Unown [V], and Unown [E] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [H]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Help]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [H], Unown [E], Unown [L], and Unown [P] on your Bench, you may shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw a new hand of the same number of cards.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [W]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Want]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [W], Unown [A], Unown [N], and Unown [T] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [X]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [XXXXX]
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, flip a coin until you get tails. That attack does 10 more damage for each heads. If you have more than 1 Unown [X] in play, use only 1 [XXXXX] each turn.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Egg Toss
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

cards.name: Dark Croconaw

attacks.name: Clamping Jaw
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

cards.name: Dark Exeggutor

attacks.name: Triple Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: MAX Burst
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

cards.name: Dark Flaaffy

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Stun Wave
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

cards.name: Dark Forretress

attacks.name: Armor Up
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if Dark Forretress would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Dark Forretress is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: Dark Forretress does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

cards.name: Dark Haunter

attacks.name: Call Back
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile onto his or her Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Surround
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

cards.name: Dark Omanyte

attacks.name: Water Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card attached to Dark Omanyte. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

cards.name: Dark Pupitar

attacks.name: Rock Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Dark Pupitar can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Explosive Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on Dark Pupitar. (This counts as evolving Dark Pupitar.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

cards.name: Dark Quilava

attacks.name: Incinerate
attacks.text: Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it.

attacks.name: Rushing Magma
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

cards.name: Dark Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Dark Song
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Slap Awake
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokémon is no longer Asleep or Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: One-Two Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Heel Drop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

cards.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: All damage done to Jigglypuff during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

cards.name: Light Dewgong

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Pillar
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Light Dewgong is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

cards.name: Light Flareon

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: If you have any benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Burning Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Flareon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

cards.name: Light Golduck

attacks.name: Flipper Stroke
attacks.text: Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his or her deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, he or she may show any number of them to you and put them into his or her hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Core Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

cards.name: Light Jolteon

attacks.name: Pulse Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to Light Jolteon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Thunder Needle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

cards.name: Light Machoke

attacks.name: Return Home
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, shuffle 1 of them and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Gentle Kick
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

cards.name: Light Ninetales

attacks.name: Guiding Flame
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Ninetales in order to use this attack.

cards.flavorText: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

cards.name: Light Slowbro

attacks.name: Fish Out
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose up to 3 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, and/or Evolution cards from his or her discard pile and shuffle them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Splash About
attacks.text: If there are more Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon than to Light Slowbro, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

cards.name: Light Vaporeon

attacks.name: Wash Away
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon and discard all Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Hypnoshower
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

cards.name: Light Venomoth

attacks.name: Mysterious Wing
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: If Light Venomoth and the Defending Pokémon have a different number of Energy cards attached to them, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

cards.name: Light Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Evolution Song
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose 1 of his or her Pokémon and search his or her deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon. Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokémon. This counts as evolving that Pokémon. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

cards.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Scyther.

cards.flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

cards.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks during your opponent's next turn, any damage it does is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spike Ball Tackle
attacks.text: Togepi does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

cards.name: Unown [C]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Chase]
abilities.text: As long as Unown [C] is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon tries to retreat, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [P]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Perform]
abilities.text: If an attack damaged Unown [P] during your opponent's last turn and Unown [P] was your Active Pokémon, Unown [P]'s Hidden Power attack does that much more damage to the Defending Pokémon. This power can be used even if Unown [P] is Confused.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [Q]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Quicken]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to any of your Pokémon with Unown in its name during your opponent's next turn. If you have more than 1 Unown [Q] in play, use only 1 [Quicken] each turn. This power can be used even if Unown [Q] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [Z]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Zoom]
abilities.text: As long as Unown [Z] is Benched, you pay no Energy cost to retreat a Pokémon with Unown in its name.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

cards.name: Dark Octillery

attacks.name: Ink Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Octillery but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Tentacle Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, your opponent pays Colorless more to retreat the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Shed
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Dratini.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Tail Bite
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

cards.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Dodge
attacks.text: If Hitmonchan would be damaged by an attack during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Hitmonchan. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

cards.name: Light Sunflora

attacks.name: Reflected Sunlight
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

cards.name: Mantine

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

cards.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Crushing Step
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.flavorText: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Migraine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

cards.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

cards.name: Seel

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Seel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Sunbathe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern. Search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach that card to Sunkern. This counts as evolving Sunkern. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

cards.name: Swinub

attacks.name: Generate Cold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

cards.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Totodile but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

cards.name: Unown [L]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Laugh]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, each player shuffles his or her deck. This power can be used even if Unown [L] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [S]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Search]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 1 of your Prize cards. Return that Prize card face down. This power can be used even if Unown [S] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [T]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Tell]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand and show your hand to your opponent. This power can be used even if Unown [T] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [V]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Vanish]
abilities.text: When you play Unown [V] from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name (other than Unown [V]) to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.

cards.flavorText: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

cards.name: Broken Ground Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Each player pays Colorless more to retreat a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon.

cards.name: EXP.ALL
rules: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokémon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon and attach it to the Pokémon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

cards.name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
rules: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

cards.name: Radio Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

cards.name: Thought Wave Machine
rules: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

cards.name: Counterattack Claws
rules: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

cards.name: Energy Amplifier
rules: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Energy Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

cards.name: Lucky Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Magnifier
rules: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

cards.name: Pokémon Personality Test
rules: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

cards.name: Heal Powder
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Mail from Bill
rules: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

cards.flavorText: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

cards.name: Shining Charizard
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.

attacks.name: White-hot Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

cards.name: Shining Kabutops
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Kabutops in your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Cut
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Water Slash
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Shining Kabutops but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

cards.name: Shining Mewtwo
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Mewtwo in your deck.

attacks.name: Reflect Shield
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Shining Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn (even if Shining Mewtwo is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shining Mewtwo from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psyburst
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Mewtwo or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

cards.name: Shining Noctowl
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Noctowl in your deck.

attacks.name: Flashing Eyes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

cards.name: Shining Raichu
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Raichu in your deck.

attacks.name: Thundersquall
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to Shining Raichu. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

cards.name: Shining Steelix
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Steelix in your deck.

attacks.name: Crushing Earth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, Shining Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Shining Tyranitar
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Tyranitar in your deck.

attacks.name: Mountain Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from his or her deck.

attacks.name: Destructive Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

cards.name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Freeze Dry
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Dark Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

cards.name: Dark Dragonite

abilities.name: Summon Minions
abilities.text: When you play Dark Dragonite from your hand, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Dark Persian

attacks.name: Fascinate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Dark Raichu

attacks.name: Surprise Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coins is heads, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If the second coin is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

cards.name: Dark Slowbro

abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.text: When you play Dark Slowbro from your hand, choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon and/or Evolution cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Fickle Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Flareon or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another (even if it would Knock Out the other Pokémon). This power can't be used if Gengar is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Under a full moon, this Pokémon like to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

cards.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Pin Missle
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Strikes Back
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out), this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is already affected by a Special Condition when your opponent attacks.

cards.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Muk

abilities.name: Toxic Gas
abilities.text: Ignore all Pokémon Powers other than Toxic Gases. This power stops working while Muk is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Sludge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Lure
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Ninetales or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Butterfree equal of half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Butterfree has fewer damage counters that that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Chain Lightning
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't Colorless, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon of the same type as the Defending Pokémon (including your own). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch Exeggutor with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Golem

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Golem does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Prophecy
attacks.text: Look at up to 3 cards from the top of either player's deck and rearrange them as you like.

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kabutops

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Kabutops equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Kabutops has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Control
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and attach it to another of your opponent's Pokémon of your choice.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Wildfire
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Moltres when you use this attack. If you do, discard that many cards from the top of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

cards.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Boyfriends
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Nidoking you have in play.

cards.flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Ram
attacks.text: Rhydon does 20 damage to itself. Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon. Switch the Pokémon even if Rhydon is Knocked Out.)

cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Arcanine or this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Charmeleon or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Dark Dragonair

abilities.name: Evolutionary Light
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Dark Dragonair is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

cards.name: Dark Wartortle

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mirror Shell
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Dark Wartortle during your opponent's next turn (even if Dark Wartortle is Knocked Out), Dark Wartortle does an equal amount of damage to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

cards.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

cards.name: Dodrio

abilities.name: Retreat Aid
abilities.text: As long as Dodrio is Benched, pay Colorless less to retreat your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dodrio.
