rules: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides Colorless Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

cards.name: Cyclone Energy
rules: Cyclone Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

cards.name: Warp Energy
rules: Warp Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Absol ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Cursed Eyes
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Absol ex from your hand onto your Bench, you may move 3 damage counters from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of his or her Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Claydol ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Type Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Claydol ex's type is Fighting until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Psychic Boom
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Crush
attacks.text: You may discard a Psychic Energy card attached to Claydol ex. If you do, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Flygon ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Protector
abilities.text: If Flygon ex is damaged by an opponent's attack, you may discard up to 4 cards from your hand. If you do, any damage done to Flygon ex is reduced by 10 for each card you discarded.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Flygon ex can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

cards.name: Metagross ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Magnetic Redraw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Metagross ex is your Active Pokémon, you may use this power. Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws 4 cards. This power can't be used if Metagross ex is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Scanblast
attacks.text: Does 70 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has the same name as the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Salamence ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Volcanic Flame
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards from your deck.

attacks.name: Hydro Wave
attacks.text: Discard all Water Energy attached to Salamence ex. This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Shiftry ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Skill Hack
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card you find there. Choose 1 of that Pokémon's attacks. Skill Hack copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) (No matter what type that Pokémon is, Shiftry ex's type is still Darkness.) Shiftry ex performs that attack.

attacks.name: Dirge
attacks.text: Does 60 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has the same name as the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Skarmory ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metal Gravity
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats and has 40 or more remaining HP, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Metal Gravity Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Walrein ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Chilling Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Walrein ex from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this power. Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 70 damage plus 20 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

cards.name: Flareon ★
rules: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon Star in your deck.

abilities.name: Crimson Ray
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Flareon Star from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Each Active Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Flareon Star.

cards.name: Jolteon ★
rules: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon Star in your deck.

abilities.name: Yellow Ray
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Jolteon Star from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on each Active Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Jolteon Star during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Vaporeon ★
rules: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon Star in your deck.

abilities.name: Blue Ray
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Vaporeon Star from your hand onto your Bench, you may remove all Special Conditions and 3 damage counters from each Active Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Time Bellow
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Flash Cannon
attacks.text: You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Dark Palm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and shuffle that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dusknoir if affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hard Feelings
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Intense Voltage
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if Elekid is anywhere under Electivire, you may move a Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. If you do, this attack's base damage is 120 instead of 60.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Infernape

attacks.name: Meteor Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Infernape.

cards.flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxray

abilities.name: Gleam Eyes
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Luxray from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Bench isn't full, choose 1 Basic Pokémon from your opponent's hand, and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lightning Star
attacks.text: Move all Lightning Energy attached to Luxray to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.text: If you have any Metal Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to Magnezone.

cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Avenge
attacks.text: Count the number of your Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Transback
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Rhyperior

abilities.name: Earth Fissure
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Rhyperior from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Rhyperior can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Spike Whip
attacks.text: If Budew is anywhere under Roserade, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Shiftry

abilities.name: Darkness Fan
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Shiftry is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Evolved Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it back into his or her hand. This power can't be used if Shiftry is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Spirit Dance
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Frustration
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that doesn't have any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Accelerative Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all damage done to Staraptor by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Brave Heart
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Staraptor does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from each of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Azumarill during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Bubble Pump
attacks.text: If Azumarill has 3 or more Energy attached to it, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If Azurill is anywhere under Azumarill, flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: After your attack, remove from Beautifly the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Bibarel

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 4 damage counters from Bibarel. Bibarel is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Bibarel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Carnivine. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Carnivine's, this attack does 60 damage instead.

attacks.name: Wring Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) Clefable performs that attack.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Wind Wave
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Supporter cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

attacks.name: Explosive Smoke
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Dustox

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Toxic Dust
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Floatzel but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Gengar

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 10 HP away from being Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Shadow Dance
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, switch Gengar with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horn Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

cards.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Vacuum Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sand Eject
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Lopunny

attacks.name: Healing Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. Remove a number of damage counters equal to the number of heads from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flop
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You may switch Lopunny with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

cards.name: Medicham

attacks.name: Force Palm
attacks.text: Count the number of damage counters on Medicham. Put that many damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.text: Medicham does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

cards.name: Munchlax

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Snorlax from your hand onto Munchlax (this counts as evolving Munchlax) and remove all damage counters from Munchlax.

attacks.name: Heave
attacks.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, this attack does nothing.) Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

cards.name: Noctowl

attacks.name: See Beyond
attacks.text: Choose a card from your hand and put it as a Prize card face up. Then, choose 1 of your face-down Prize cards without looking and put it into your hand. This attack does nothing if all of your Prize cards are face up.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 30 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Purugly

attacks.name: High Hat
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

cards.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Block
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Ease Up
attacks.text: Snorlax is now Asleep. If Snorlax is evolved from Munchlax, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.text: Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Leaf Honey
attacks.text: Discard a Grass Energy attached to Vespiquen and remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Grass Pokémon.

attacks.name: Attack Order
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Grass Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the total amount of Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Countercharge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, move all damage counters from Wobbuffet to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Wynaut

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Wobbuffet from your hand onto Wynaut (this counts as evolving Wynaut) and remove all damage counters from Wynaut.

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

cards.name: Budew

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Roselia from your hand onto Budew (this counts as evolving Budew) and remove all damage counters from Budew.

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

cards.name: Cascoon

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Cascoon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Cascoon if that damage is 30 or less.

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

cards.name: Cherrim

attacks.name: Worry Seed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Cherrim.

cards.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Blowing Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ominous Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Roam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gravity Wave
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that doesn't have a Retreat Cost. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Elekid

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Electabuzz from your hand onto Elekid (this counts as evolving Elekid) and remove all damage counters from Elekid.

attacks.name: Outlet
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

cards.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

cards.name: Hippopotas

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

cards.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Karate Chop

attacks.text: If you have Mesprit and Azelf in play, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Abomasnow

abilities.name: Glacier Snow
abilities.text: If Abomasnow is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Abomasnow is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Heavy Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

cards.name: Ariados

abilities.name: Sticky
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost for each player's Pokémon (excluding Ariados) is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Offensive Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

cards.name: Bastiodon

abilities.name: Protective Wall
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Anger Revenge
attacks.text: If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Call In
attacks.text: Draw a card. If Chingling is anywhere under Chimecho, draw 2 more cards.

attacks.name: Strange Bell
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, that Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

cards.name: Crobat

abilities.name: Evolutionary Toxic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Crobat from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Strike and Fade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, shuffle Crobat and all cards attached to it back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: String Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each basic Energy card attached to Exeggutor and to the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Nutritional Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

cards.name: Glalie

abilities.name: Craggy Face
abilities.text: As long as Glalie is your Active Pokémon, any damage done by attacks from your opponent's Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Intimidation Pebble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards or Supporter cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Gyarados

abilities.name: Dragon DNA
abilities.text: Gyarados can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.) If Gyarados uses any attack from its Basic Pokémon, that attack does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Enrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If the first coin is tails, Gyarados is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Sore Performance
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Concerto
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Kricketot and each Kricketune you have in play.

cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Manectric

attacks.name: Lightning Twister
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of basic Energy cards attached to Manectric.

attacks.name: Chain Lightning
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that is the same type as the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mantine

abilities.name: Jumbo Fin
abilities.text: If Mantyke is anywhere under Mantine, the Retreat Cost for each of your Water Pokémon is ColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: Mantine can't use Giant Wave during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Airy Wall
abilities.text: If your opponent's Pokémon that has 2 or less Energy cards attached to it attacks Mr. Mime, prevent all damage done to Mr. Mime from that attack. If Mime Jr. is anywhere under Mr. Mime, prevent all effects of that attack, including damage, done to Mr. Mime.

attacks.name: Trick Play
attacks.text: Put a coin next to your Active Pokémon without showing your opponent and cover it with your hand. Your opponent guesses if the coin is heads or tails. If he or she is wrong, this attack does 50 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If he or she is right, Mr. Mime does 20 damage to itself, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

cards.name: Nidoqueen

abilities.name: Mother Pheromone
abilities.text: The attack cost of your Nidoran ♀, Nidorina, Nidoran ♂, Nidorino, and Nidoking's attacks is Colorless less.

attacks.name: Give Aid
attacks.text: If you have the same number of or less Benched Pokémon than your opponent, this attack's base damage is 50 instead of 90.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Color Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Ninetales is the same type as that Pokémon (all if that Pokémon is more than 1 type) until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Ninetales.

cards.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Rampardos

attacks.name: Assurance
attacks.text: As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30.

attacks.name: Hasty Headbutt

cards.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

cards.name: Slaking

abilities.name: Energetic Impulse
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Slaking is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, Slaking's Lazy Blow attack's base damage is 130 during this turn. If tails, Slaking can't attack or retreat during this turn. (If Slaking is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.)

cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Sidestep
attacks.text: If Bonsly is anywhere under Sudowoodo, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Sudowoodo during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Persuade
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

cards.name: Toxicroak

abilities.name: Poison Sacs
abilities.text: Your opponent can't remove the Special Condition Poisoned by evolving or devolving his or her Poisoned Pokémon. (This also includes putting a Pokémon Level-Up card onto the Poisoned Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Knuckle Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Unown [I]

abilities.name: ITEM
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown I, Unown T, Unown E, and Unown M on your Bench, you may search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 ITEM Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it face down. Treat that card as a Special Energy card that provides Colorless Energy and doesn't have any effect other than providing Energy. Put that card face up at the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Bad Temper
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Defensive Claw
attacks.text: If Teddiursa is on your Bench, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If Teddiursa is on your Bench and has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and remove all damage counters from that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Walrein

abilities.name: Freeze-up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Walrein from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip 2 coins. If both are heads, discard 1 of the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Ice Bind
attacks.text: If your opponent doesn't discard a card from his or her hand, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Whiscash

attacks.name: Fury
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Whiscash.

attacks.name: Magnitude
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

cards.name: Bayleef

attacks.name: Evolution Impulse
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Boomerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Chingling

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chimecho from your hand onto Chingling (this counts as evolving Chingling) and remove all damage counters from Chingling.

attacks.name: Inviting Bell
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

cards.name: Cranidos

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

cards.name: Croconaw

abilities.name: Evolutionary Vitality
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Croconaw from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose all Energy cards you find there, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Hover Over
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Dewgong

abilities.name: Cold Fat
abilities.text: As long as Dewgong is Asleep, any damage done to Dewgong by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: Dewgong is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

cards.name: Dodrio

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Triple Pick
attacks.text: Choose 3 of your opponent's Evolved Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Snake Hook
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Bite and Run
attacks.text: Switch Dunsparce with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Gather Up
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Marvelous Shine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads put 4 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Crane Neck
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

cards.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Pulse Search
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

cards.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Rock Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

cards.name: Happiny

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chansey from your hand onto Happiny (this counts as evolving Happiny) and remove all damage counters from Happiny.

attacks.name: Lively
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Mend
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Metal Energy card and attach it to Lairon. If you do, remove 2 damage counters from Lairon.

cards.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Magmar.

cards.flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

cards.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Centrifugal Force
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Colorless Energy in the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost (after applying effects to the Retreat Cost).

attacks.name: Swirling Ripple
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Water Pokémon in play, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Rescue
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Crash Bomber
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Special Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. Then, discard a Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Liner
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Wild Spores
attacks.text: If Parasect evolved from Paras during this turn, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Extend Fungus
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Parasect.

cards.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

cards.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Pressurized Gas
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Pupitar by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Quilava.

cards.flavorText: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

cards.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Spike Armor
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Sandslash is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sandslash is Knocked Out), put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Spike
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, that Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

cards.name: Sealeo

attacks.name: Ice Rider
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Shieldon

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shieldon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shield Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Bonus Leaf
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

cards.name: Unown [E]

abilities.name: EQUIP
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown E is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown E and attach Unown E to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown E is attached to a Pokémon, that Pokémon gets +10 HP.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever your opponent flips a coin, treat it as tails.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [M]

abilities.name: MAGNET
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown M is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Unown M is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [T]

abilities.name: THROW
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown T is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a card from your hand. Then, flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Unown T is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck. Then, show your opponent your hand and he or she chooses 1 card. Shuffle that card into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Wake-up Punch
attacks.text: If Vigoroth evolved from Slakoth during this turn and Slakoth was Asleep, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 10.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

cards.name: Abra

attacks.name: Play Search
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other 4 cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ultra Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for Alakazam and put it on Abra (this counts as evolving Abra). Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

cards.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Throw Off
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

cards.name: Aron

attacks.name: Steel Tackle
attacks.text: Aron does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Barboach

attacks.name: Mud Spit
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

cards.name: Bidoof
rules: Wacan Berry: Any damage done to Bidoof by attacks from Lightning Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Dull Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Buizel
rules: Chesto Berry: If Buizel is Asleep, remove the Special Condition Asleep from Buizel at the end of each player's turn.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Scrunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Chansey does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

cards.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Sleep Scent
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Ghastly Sound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Finger Poke
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Double Stab
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: Doduo can't use Accelerating Stab during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Jam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't attach any Energy cards from his or her hand to the Active Pokémon during his or her next turn.

cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Direct-hit Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggcute. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Finneon

attacks.name: Elegant Swim
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Finneon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

cards.name: Geodude

attacks.name: Stone Throw
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

cards.name: Gible

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Mountain Bite
attacks.text: You may discard the top card of your deck. If you do, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage and Larvitar is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Magby

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Magmar from your hand onto Magby (this counts as evolving Magby) and remove all damage counters from Magby.

attacks.name: Scorch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.

attacks.name: Dragon Rage
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Swarm
attacks.text: Search your deck for Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Hide Crowd
attacks.text: Switch Murkrow with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for Nidoran ♂ or Nidoran ♀ and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Mushroom Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu.

attacks.name: Chupi
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

cards.name: Pikachu

abilities.name: Electro Recycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Pichu is anywhere under Pikachu, you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. This power can't be used if Pikachu is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: BikaBika
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

cards.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

cards.name: Seel

attacks.name: Freezing Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

cards.name: Shinx
rules: Rawst Berry: If Shinx is Burned, remove the Special Condition Burned from Shinx at the end of each player's turn.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Shinx.

cards.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Drowsy
attacks.text: Both Slakoth and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Snowball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

cards.name: Snover

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Snowball Fight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Snover does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

cards.name: Spheal

attacks.name: Willpower
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your next turn, Spheal's Rollout attack's base damage is 40.

cards.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

cards.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Sleep Inducer
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Teddiursa

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 2 damage counters from Teddiursa. Teddiursa is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Sweet Palm
attacks.text: Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Shining Fang
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Fire Soul
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Bebe's Search
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

cards.name: Dusk Ball
rules: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Fossil Excavator
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your deck or discard pile for a Trainer card that has Fossil in its name or a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolution card that evolves from a Fossil. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Lake Boundary
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×2 instead.

cards.name: Night Maintenance
rules: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: Quick Ball
rules: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Pokémon. Show that Pokémon to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards back into your deck. (If you don't reveal a Pokémon, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

cards.name: Team Galactic's Wager
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, and you and your opponent play "Rock-Paper-Scissors." The player who wins draws up to 6 cards. The player who loses draws up to 3 cards. (You draw your cards first.)

cards.name: Armor Fossil
rules: Play Armor Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Armor Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Armor Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Armor Stone
abilities.text: Whenever Armor Fossil would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, reduce that damage by 10.

cards.name: Skull Fossil
rules: Play Skull Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Skull Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Skull Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Skull Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Skull Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Skull Stone
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if Skull Fossil would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Multi Energy
rules: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides Colorless Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

cards.name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Electivire LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Electivire. Electivire LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Shocking Tail
abilities.text: As long as Electivire is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pulse Barrier
attacks.text: Discard all of your opponent's Pokémon Tool cards and Stadium cards in play. If you do, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Electivire during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Lucario LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Lucario. Lucario LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Lucario LV.X from your hand onto your Active Lucario, you may use this power. Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Lucario during your opponent's next turn. (If Lucario is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.)

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Lucario by attacks is increased by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Magmortar LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Magmortar. Magmortar LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Torrid Wave
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Magmortar is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Burned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 2 on that Pokémon between turns. This power can't be used if Magmortar is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flame Bluster
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) During your next turn, Magmortar can't use Flame Bluster.

cards.name: Time-Space Distortion
rules: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Bastiodon

abilities.name: Protective Wall
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Anger Revenge
attacks.text: If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Rampardos

attacks.name: Assurance
attacks.text: As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30.

attacks.name: Hasty Headbutt
attacks.text: Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Blowing Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ominous Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Gible
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Gible at the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Pikachu
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Pikachu at the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Staravia

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

cards.name: Bidoof

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, an put it into your hand.

cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Jump Kick
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Cherubi

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Cherubi.

cards.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads discard a Fire Energy attached to Chimchar.

cards.flavorText: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Spash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Starly

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Jamming
abilities.text: After your opponent plays a Supporter card from his or her hand, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Jamming Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Cluster Bolt
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Waterlog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach as many basic Water Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Fury Blaze
abilities.text: If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blast Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Entei

abilities.name: Burning Coat
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Blaze Roar
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Entei.

cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Irritating Buzz
