attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. If Budew is anywhere under Roselia, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Stalk
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dangerous Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Snover

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Snover during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

cards.name: Starly

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Double Stab
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Gnaw and Run
attacks.text: Switch Stunky with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Swinub

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Swinub does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Ingrain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to Tangela. Shuffle your deck afterward. If you do, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Tangela during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

cards.name: Treecko

attacks.name: Call for Friends
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Voltorb

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to that Pokémon until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Voltorb

attacks.name: Outlet
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Bouncing Ball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Voltorb does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Conductive Quarry
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin. If heads, that player searches his or her discard pile for a Lightning or Metal Energy card, shows it to the opponent, and puts it into his or her hand.

cards.name: Energy Link
rules: Attach Energy Link to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

As long as Energy Link is attached to a Pokémon, you may move an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to another of your Pokémon that has Energy Link attached to it. You may use this effect as often as you like during your turn.

cards.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Great Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Luxury Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Marley's Request
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your discard pile for 2 different Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand, and discard the other card. (If all Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your discard pile have the same name, choose 1 of them. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand.)

cards.name: Poké Blower +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Blower + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Blower +, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Blower +, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Drawer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Drawer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Drawer +, draw a card. If you play 2 Poké Drawer +, search your deck for up to 2 cards, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Poké Healer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Healer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Healer +, remove 1 damage counter and a Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Healer +, remove 8 damage counters and all Special Conditions from 1 of your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Premier Ball
rules: Search your deck or your discard pile for a Pokémon LV.X, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you search your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Potion
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Cyclone Energy
rules: Cyclone Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

cards.name: Warp Energy
rules: Warp Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Dusknoir LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Dusknoir. Dusknoir LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm
abilities.text: If Dusknoir is your Active Pokémon and would be Knocked Out by damage from your opponent's attack, you may discard all cards attached to Dusknoir LV.X and put Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card into play instead of discarding it. This counts as Dusknoir being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card. As long as you have Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card in play, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon between turns. If another Stadium card comes into play or Dusknoir LV.X is discarded by the effects of any attacks, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, Trainer, or Supporter cards, return Dusknoir LV.X to your hand.

cards.name: Heatran LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Heatran. Heatran LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Heat Metal
abilities.text: Your opponent can't remove the Special Condition Burned by evolving or devolving his or her Burned Pokémon. (This also includes putting a Pokémon Level-Up card onto the Burned Pokémon.) Whenever your opponent flips a coin for the Special Condition Burned between turns, treat it as tails.

abilities.name: Heat Wave
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn, if Heatran is on your Bench, you may use this power. If you discarded basic Energy cards attached to your Fire or Metal Active Pokémon by using that Pokémon's attack this turn, attach up to 2 of those Energy cards to that Pokémon.

cards.name: Machamp LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Machamp. Machamp LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.text: As long as Machamp is your Active Pokémon, each of Machamp's attacks does 60 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) and any damage done to Machamp by your opponent's Pokémon is increased by 60 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Strong-Willed
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Machamp would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

cards.name: Raichu LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Raichu. Raichu LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Link Lightning
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Raichu LV.X onto Raichu and use Voltage Shoot, you may use another attack of Raichu afterward. This power can't be used if Raichu is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Voltage Shoot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand and choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Regigigas LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Regigigas. Regigigas LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and that Pokémon is Knocked Out. Then, search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, attach them to Regigigas, and remove 8 damage counters from Regigigas. This power can't be used if Regigigas is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giga Blaster
attacks.text: Discard the top card from your opponent's deck. Then, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. Regigigas can't use Giga Blaster during your next turn.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Charmander.

cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Charmeleon.

cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: All Energy attached to Charizard are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Charizard.

cards.flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.text: If Drifloon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, Drifloon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Big Explosion
attacks.text: Drifloon does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.text: Put up to 3 damage counters on Duskull. Then, put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fastball

attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Voltorb.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Damage Bind
abilities.text: Each Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (both yours and your opponent's) can't use any Poké-Powers.

attacks.name: Gigavolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Ampharos to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Dig Well
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck, choose as many Water Energy cards as you like, and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Discard the other cards. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Aqua Press
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Double Launcher
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Blastoise. Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Blastoise can't use Double Launcher during your next turn.

abilities.name: Fire Breath

attacks.name: Clutch

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Blaziken.

abilities.name: Power Circulation
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put those cards on top of your deck in any order. If you do, put 2 damage counters on Delcatty. This power can't be used if Delcatty is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Power Heal
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Delcatty. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Delcatty.

cards.name: Dialga

abilities.name: Reverse Time
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Dialga from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X) and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and put them on top of your deck in any order.

attacks.name: Time-Space Traveling
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dialga

abilities.name: Time Aura
abilities.text: As long as Dialga is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from his or her hand to evolve his or her Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Burn
attacks.text: Discard all Metal Energy attached to Dialga.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

attacks.name: Deafen
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Psychic Protection
attacks.text: Gardevoir has no Weakness during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Let Loose
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Giratina from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws up to 4 cards. (You draw your cards first.)

attacks.name: Earth Power

attacks.name: Over Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

attacks.name: Dark Wing Flaps
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

abilities.name: Electric Barrier
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon (excluding any Manectric) by attacks.

attacks.name: Power Wave

attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Pearl Breath
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Iron Skull
abilities.text: Rampardos's attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Head Smash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon would be Knocked Out by this attack, Rampardos does 40 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Mold Breaker
attacks.text: Any damage done to Rampardos by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Flower Aroma
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Shaymin. The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Damage Aid
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 30 damage plus 50 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to Shaymin.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to Shaymin.

cards.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

cards.name: Slaking

abilities.name: Lazy Paunch
abilities.text: If Slaking used any attacks during your last turn, Slaking can't attack.

attacks.name: Best Dash
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Slaking by attacks is increased by 50 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Pokémon SP and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Team Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Pokémon SP you have in play.

attacks.name: Midnight Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Perish Song
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep and was damaged or affected by Midnight Eyes during your last turn, the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Healing Song
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Temper Tantrum
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard as many cards as you like from your hand. If you do, put that many damage counters on Banette. This power can't be used if Banette is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Darkness Switch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Banette, and then switch all damage counters on Banette with those on the Defending Pokémon. (If an effect of this attack is prevented, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Loneliness
attacks.text: You may show your hand to your opponent. If you do and if you don't have any Pokémon in your hand, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

abilities.name: Metal Trait
abilities.text: As long as Bastiodon has a Pokémon Tool attached to it, remove 1 damage counter from Bastiodon between turns.

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Bastiodon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.text: Bastiodon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Colorful Powder
attacks.text: If Beautifly has 2 or less Energy attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If Beautifly has 3 Energy attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. If Beautifly has 4 or more Energy attached to it, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Burned, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Silver Scale
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Resistance, this attack's base damage is 60 damage instead of 30.

cards.flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

abilities.name: Nurse Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Nurse Call Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Blissey does 60 damage to itself.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Energy Stream
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Dialga.

attacks.name: Diamond Blow
attacks.text: Dialga can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

abilities.name: Sinkhole
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Magnitude
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Camouflage Pattern
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Dustox by your opponent's Pokémon that is affected by 2 or more Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Smogscreen
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Chemical Scale
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Jet Smash
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Empoleon can't use Jet Smash during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Giratina

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch Giratina with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Broken-space Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out by this attack, put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cards.name: Giratina

attacks.name: Dragonbreath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Swim
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Water Energy attached to any of his or her Pokémon, you may do 30 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Water Slide
attacks.text: You may move all Energy cards attached to Golduck to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

attacks.name: Wriggle
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your opponent's Pokémon. If that coin flip is heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 100 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gyarados G.

cards.name: Infernape

attacks.name: Rushing Flames
attacks.text: Discard as many Fire Energy cards as you like attached to your Pokémon in play. Flip a coin for each Energy card you discarded. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Infernape.

cards.flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fires on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Revenge Melody
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Kricketot and Kricketune in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Bug Buzz
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage. Remove the Special Condition Asleep from the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Harrumph
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Before doing damage, discard all Trainer cards attached to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Body Press
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

abilities.name: Cheerful Voice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Ludicolo is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Mad Dance
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Best Dance
attacks.text: After doing damage, remove from Ludicolo the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon. Ludicolo can't use Best Dance during your next turn.

cards.name: Luvdisc

attacks.name: Love Call
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Search your deck for a Pokémon that is the same type as the Pokémon you chose, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

cards.name: Ninetales

cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Combusken

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Grotle.

cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Monferno.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Gaze

cards.flavorText: It skillfully control the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

cards.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

attacks.name: Rock Slide

cards.flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

cards.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Vigoroth does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Fight Back
attacks.text: If Vigoroth has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.text: Wartortle does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

abilities.name: Thick Skin

cards.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

attacks.name: Poison Breath

attacks.name: Sweet Saliva
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey. If tails, remove 3 damage counters from the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pulled Punch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 40.

cards.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Chimchar

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

attacks.text: Search your deck for Grimer and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chansey from your hand onto Happiny (this counts as evolving Happiny) and remove all damage counters from Happiny.

cards.flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running

attacks.name: Expand

attacks.name: Take Back
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

attacks.name: Pull

cards.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

attacks.name: Trickle

cards.flavorText: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

attacks.name: Steady Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze

cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Tauros does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

attacks.name: Focus Energy

attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Torkoal to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray

cards.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

cards.name: Broken Time-Space
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Each player may evolve a Pokémon that he or she just played or evolved during that turn.

cards.name: Cyrus's Conspiracy
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your deck for a Supporter card, a basic Energy card, and a Trainer card that has Team Galactic's Invention in its name, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Galactic HQ
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Whenever any player plays any Pokémon from his or her hand to evolve his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Level Max
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon LV.X that levels up from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon. (This counts as leveling up that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Life Herb
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your Pokémon, and remove all Special Conditions and 6 damage counters from that Pokémon (all if there are less than 6).

cards.name: Looker's Investigation
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Look at your opponent's hand, then choose you or your opponent. That player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws up to 5 cards.

cards.name: Memory Berry
rules: Attach Memory Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon or its Stage 1 Evolution card. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

cards.name: Miasma Valley
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Whenever any player puts a Basic Pokémon (excluding Grass or Psychic Pokémon) from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: PlusPower
rules: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn.
If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Pokédex HANDY910is
rules: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Pokémon Rescue
rules: Search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
rules: Attach Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain to 1 of your Pokémon SP that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is no longer a Pokémon SP, discard this card.

attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon for each Pokémon Tool and Stadium card your opponent has in play. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Poison Seed
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Rotom. Flip a coin for each Energy card you discarded. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Uproar
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

attacks.name: Silver Feather
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, when your opponent puts a Basic Pokémon from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Max
attacks.text: Discard all Metal Energy attached to Skarmory FB. Flip a coin for each Energy card you discarded. This attack does 20 damage plus 40 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Staravia

attacks.name: Double Peck
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Air Crash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Togekiss C does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Wailmer

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Wailmer but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Wailmer does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

cards.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to Yanma.

cards.flavorText: It can hover is one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

cards.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Pit Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Bidoof

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: Switch Buneary with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mini Drain
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Buneary.

cards.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

cards.name: Chatot

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Chatot does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Cherubi

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Attach a Grass Energy from your hand to Cherubi.

cards.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Chingling

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chimecho from your hand onto Chingling (this counts as evolving Chingling) and remove all damage counters from Chingling.

attacks.name: Chime
attacks.text: Search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.)

cards.flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

cards.name: Combee

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Combee.

cards.flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
